༄༅/ /ma mgon gnyis kyi gtor bsngos bsdus pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// ma mgon gnyis kyi gtor bsngos bsdus pa bzhugs so//

bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// mgon po phyag bzhi'i gtor ma bsngo ba ni/ gtor ma byin rlabs byas te/ rang nyid 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma lā ye s+t+waṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shapad pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ lha rnams kyi ljags 'od kyi rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyi rnam pas drangs te gsol bas tshim par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā ya/ shā sa na u pa hā ri ṇi/ e ṣa a pash+tsi ma kā lo a yaṃ i daṃ rat+na tra yā ya/ a pa kā ri ṇaṃ/ ya di pra tidzñā sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ duṣ+ṭāṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ bhan+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na/ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa i daṃ ba liṃ khā hi khā hi/ oṃ badz+ra ka wu wa wa pā sha ya ma hā kā lā ya i daṃ ba liṃ khā hi khā hi/ oṃ ma hā kā lī i daṃ ba liṃ khā hi khā hi/ oṃ ma hā kā lā su tri ya ma du dzaḥ.i daṃ ba ling khā hi khā hi/ oṃ ma hā kā lā trak+shad dzaḥ.i daṃ ba liṃ khā hi khā hi/ oṃ ma hā kā lā singha mu kha i daṃ ba liṃ khā hi khā hi/ oṃ ma hā kā lā sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ khā hi khā hi/ gtor ma dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag 'dod yon bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po 'di nyid/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po rdo rje nag po chen po phyag bzhi pa/ thugs yum dmar nag /tshe bdag bya rog gi gdong pa can/ srog bdag bya rog gi gdong pa can/ 'chi bdag bya rog gi gdong pa can/ gnod sbyin bya rog gi gdong pa can/ phyag brnyan seṅge'i gdong pa can/ mkha' 'gro ma brgyad/ nag po stong*/ sha za 'bum/ ma mo bye ba/ gang po mdzes ma/ gnod sbyin khri/ pho nya sde brgyad/ snang srid 'jig rten dregs pa'i dmag tshogs/

sprul pa yang sprul bya khyi gcan gzan la sogs pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du i daṃ ba liṃ khā hi khā hi/ khyed rnams mnyes shing tshims nas dam ldan sgrub pa po la dgyes pa'i zhal ston/ sgrub pa'i rtags phyung*/ phrin las mngon du gyis/ bka' dang bstan pa srungs/ 'khor dang gang zag skyongs/ dpal dang grags pa sgrubs/ sdang bar byed ba'i dgra sod/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs thul/ bar du gcod pa'i rkyen zlog /zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin las ma lus pa lhun gyis 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ sngags rnams lan gsum bya/ skabs 'dir spro na gsang ba gsol gdab/ mnga' gsol/ bskang bshags/ mchod bstod sogs kyang bya'o// // ༈ /a phyi la gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum/ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gha mu ā tsit+te shwa ri dharma tā re ma ma tsakra swā hā/ sarba 'dus/ yar 'dus/ mar 'dus/ ma ma dzñā na tā ra 'dus/ gha mu sa ma ya tā ra/ dhe ma ḍā ki nī ma ma 'dus/ bha dzaṃ i daṃ bha liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gtor ma 'dod yon phun sum tshogs pa 'di nyid/ a phyi sna nam bza' dbang phyug chos kyi sgrol ma/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro gtsug na nor bu/ dam tshig gi mkha' 'gro yid bzhin nor bu/ dbang gi mkha' 'gro khams gsum gzi 'phrog /sha za las kyi mkha' 'gro chen mo/ jo mo bkra shis tshe ring ma mched lnga/ 'khor brtan ma bcu gnyis ye shes dang las las grub pa'i ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ khyad par chos rje'i bka' srung thugs dam can// las su sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po srungs// zas su dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod gtor 'bul// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// de ltar ma mgon gnyis la gtor 'bul gyi las rim mdor bsdus pa 'di'ang*| zhabs drung lcam drung nas dgos gsungs par 'bri gung pa rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pas mgyogs par bris pa'o//
